scripts.text:
[Guide]
This castle has a hidden secret.
That is the ^4d4dff'Okolnir'^000000.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
這座城堡隱藏著一個秘密。
那就是^4d4dff“奧科爾尼爾”^000000。

scripts.text: About Okolnir.
scripts.translation: 關於奧科爾尼爾

scripts.text: Go to Okolnir.
scripts.translation: 前往奧科爾尼爾

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Okolnir is a kind of virtual realm...
I don't know how Okolnir exists, but I guess only Valkyrie knows.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
奧科爾尼爾是一種虛擬領域......
我不知道它為何存在，不過我想只有瓦爾基里才清楚。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
As you know this is a place to test the adventurers made by Valkyrie...
...you know the qualifications to enter Okolnir.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
如你所知，這是瓦爾基里用來考驗冒險者的地方......
你應該知道進入奧科爾尼爾的條件。

scripts.text: Qualifications?
scripts.translation: 條件？

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Yes, Valkyrie definitely prefers strong adventurers.
Only the qualified can enter Okolnir and Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
沒錯，瓦爾基里確實更青睞強大的冒險者。
只有符合條件的人才能進入奧科爾尼爾和瓦爾哈拉。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
It only opens when everyone comes together to work it out.
The key is in the castle.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
只有大家齊心協力，奧科爾尼爾才會開啟。
鑰匙就在城堡裡。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
If a castle's ^4d4dffeconomy is over 65 and defense also over 30^000000, this will be acceptable to access Okolnir.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
只要城堡的^4d4dff經濟值超過65，且防禦值超過30^000000，便符合進入奧科爾尼爾的條件。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
And, if you pass all of the tests given by Valkyrie in Okolnir!
You will also receive a mysterious gift.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
而且，只要通過瓦爾基里在奧科爾尼爾設下的所有考驗，就能獲得一份神秘禮物！

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Would you like to try to enter here?
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
您想嘗試進入這裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Great! Economy and Defense are OK.
You can enter Okolnir now....
Do you want to go there?
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
太好了！城堡的經濟和防禦都達標了。
現在可以進入奧科爾尼爾......
要去嗎？

scripts.text: Sure let's go there.
scripts.translation: 好的，我們走吧

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Ok......
Please follow me...

[Guide]
You can try this anytime in the future...
If you are ready to protect this castle.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
以後隨時都可以再來嘗試......
等你準備好守護這座城堡時再來。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
You are not qualified yet.
Please develop your castle more...
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
你目前還不符合條件。
請繼續發展城堡......

scripts.text:
[Guide]
... OK...
Good luck.
Enter now.
scripts.translation: 現在進入

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Hope you get everything you want...
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
希望你能如願以償......

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Really?
Sorry to hear that.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
真的嗎？
聽到這個訊息我很遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Building Okolnir needs quite a long time.
....even though it's only virtual...
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
建造奧科爾尼爾需要相當長的時間......
儘管它只是一個虛擬領域。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
It takes about 12 - 13 hours to create the virtual realm.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
建立這個虛擬領域大約需要12到13個小時。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
You'll have to wait.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
你得等待。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
... I've never seen you before.
You are strangers here. You'd better get out of here right now.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
......我以前沒見過你。
你是陌生人，最好馬上離開這裡。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I am... Wish maiden.
Mourning in this virtual realm, Okolnir.
On behalf of the humanbeings who defeated God here.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
我......是許願少女。
我在虛擬領域奧科爾尼爾中哀悼，
悼念曾在此擊敗神明的人類。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Are you ready to endure the trials to get the Goddess' glory?
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
你準備好接受試煉，贏得女神的榮耀了嗎？

scripts.text: [Wish Maiden]
scripts.translation: [許願少女]

scripts.text: Are you ready to endure the trials to get the Goddess' glory?
scripts.translation: 你準備好接受試煉，贏得女神的榮耀了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I am
scripts.translation: 是的，我準備好了

scripts.text: Sorry, I'll try later
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我稍後再來

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I will test whether or not you deserve the Goddess shine...
Isn't it simple?
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
我會考驗你是否配得上女神的光輝......
這很簡單，不是嗎？

[Wish Maiden]
Okolnir is a virtual place.
There is no room for error there.
^ff0000You only have one hour.^000000

奧科爾尼爾是個虛擬領域。
那裡容不得半點差錯。
^ff0000你只有一小時。^000000

scripts.translation: [許願少女]

You will have to wait again...
scripts.translation:

如果你沒能在規定時間內完成，奧科爾尼爾就會被摧毀，而我也將安息。
你們只能再等一次......
